name: Advance Ship Notice Quantity
description: The number of units specified in the Advance Ship Notice for a particular line item, representing the expected quantity delivered.

name: Bill Reference
description: A reference code linking the transaction to a specific invoice or bill issued by the business.

name: Booked Quantity
description: The actual number of units booked or reserved for receipt, reflecting the quantity ordered by the customer or internal system.

name: Case Units
description: The number of individual units (e.g., packs) that are bundled together in a single case or carton for storage and shipment.

name: Case Weight In Kilograms
description: The total weight in kilograms of all items within a single case, used to calculate shipping costs and inventory metrics.

name: Complaint
description: The timestamp when a complaint was first submitted or recorded in the system. This represents the initial entry point of a customer issue in the system, and is used to track when a complaint originated.

name: Container
description: A 12-digit barcode identifier uniquely assigned to a specific physical container or pallet in the supply chain.

name: Cost Price In Indian Rupees
description: The total cost incurred to acquire or produce one unit of the product, including procurement and handling expenses, in Indian Rupees.

name: Customer Order
description: A unique identifier for each customer order, formatted as 'SO' followed by a date and sequence number.

name: Delivery
description: The timestamp indicating when a delivery was made. This captures the exact moment of delivery, useful for tracking timelines and operational efficiency in fresh delivery operations.

name: Delivery Line
description: The sequential position of an item within a shipment, indicating its order in the delivery sequence.

name: Delivery Packaging
description: The total number of crates used to transport the delivered goods. This reflects packaging and logistics volume.

name: Delivery Quantity
description: The total number of individual units of a product delivered. This reflects the quantity at the item level (e.g., individual bottles, slices).

name: Distribution Center Slot
description: The specific storage location within a distribution center where the product is held, identified by a unique alphanumeric slot code.

name: Forecast
description: A single term for the core forecast entity, encompassing all attributes related to inventory forecasting and replenishment decisions. This table represents a unified forecast record for a product (SKU), capturing both demand estimates and inventory levels with associated parameters such as reorder points and order-up-to levels. All fields are part of one cohesive business concept: the sales and inventory forecast for a product over time, including uncertainty and operational thresholds. No secondary entities or junctions are implied here; all attributes belong to this single forecast entity. No archival or historical suffix is present in the table name, so no prefixing is required.

name: Global Trade Item Number
description: A global trade item number that uniquely identifies a specific product across supply chains and retail systems. Used for standardization in international supply chain operations.

name: Goods Receipt Note
description: A unique identifier for each Goods Receipt Note, formatted as GRN followed by a date code, used to track individual inbound deliveries.

name: Initiated Date And Time
description: The exact date and time when a payment transaction was first initiated by the system.

name: Inventory Count
description: The date and time when the physical inventory count was performed. This captures the moment of actual counting activity in the system, serving as a timestamp for audit and reporting purposes.

name: Inventory Date
description: The date representing the specific day for which inventory data is recorded. This captures the day-end inventory status for a given product SKU.

name: Inventory On Hand At Close
description: The number of units of a product available in inventory at the end of a specific day.

name: Line Item
description: The sequence number of the line item within a goods receipt, indicating the order in which items were received.

name: Packaging Unit
description: The unit of measurement for the product's individual packaging, such as weight or volume, indicating how much is contained per pack.

name: Pallet
description: A unique identifier for each physical pallet, typically representing a barcode or product serial number. This identifies the specific unit of packaging within a shipment.

name: Payment Amount
description: The total transaction amount in Indian Rupees (INR) for the payment.

name: Payment Attempt
description: The sequence number of the attempt to process a payment, where 1 is the first attempt and higher values indicate subsequent retries.

name: Payment Bill
description: A unique identifier for each bill transaction, formatted as a string with a prefix and sequential number. This identifies the specific bill associated with the payment.

name: Payment Method
description: The method of payment used, such as UPI, cash, or card.

name: Payment Note
description: Additional free-text information or remarks associated with the transaction, such as special instructions or notes from staff.

name: Payment Till Status
description: The outcome of the payment processing at the till, indicating whether it was approved, declined, or failed.

name: Payment Transaction
description: The exact timestamp when the payment transaction was initiated or processed.

name: Payment Transaction Reference
description: A unique reference number generated by the payment system to identify and track each transaction.

name: Pick Confirmation
description: The primary event record for when an item was picked from the warehouse, capturing the exact timestamp of fulfillment activity in the storage process.

name: Pick Confirmation Details
description: Core attributes of a pick confirmation, including order and shipment context, product details, fulfillment quantities, and the method used to verify availability.

name: Product
description: A unique identifier for a specific product, such as a type and size of item.

name: Product Freshness
description: The date by which a product must be used or consumed, ensuring freshness and safety. Critical for perishable goods like dairy and produce.

name: Product GTIN
description: A global trade item number that uniquely identifies a specific product variant in the supply chain.

name: Product Name
description: The full product name including type, ingredient, and size, as displayed to customers in the marketplace or store.

name: Product Packaging
description: The total number of cases (standard containers) included in a shipment for a given SKU.

name: Product SKU
description: A unique identifier for a product, such as a type and size of food item (e.g., 'ATTA-WW-5KG' for 5kg wheat atta).

name: Product SKU (store014.store.products)
description: A unique identifier for a product variant, such as its type and size, used to distinguish different offerings in the inventory. This is a core identifying field for product variants within the system.

name: Product SKU (store014.warehouse.shipping_notice_lines)
description: A unique product identifier that defines the type and size of a specific item, such as atta or sugar.

name: Product (store014.store.fresh_deliveries)
description: A unique product identifier representing a specific item, like MILK-TONED-500ML or BREAD-WHITE-400G. This identifies the type and variant of the product delivered.

name: Product (store014.store.stock_counts)
description: The unique identifier for a specific product, such as a grain or spice with its packaging size. This identifies the item being counted and ensures accurate tracking across inventory records.

name: Product Units
description: The total number of individual units (e.g., bags or packets) contained within the cases for a specific product.

name: Purchase Order
description: A unique identifier for each sales order, formatted as a string with the prefix 'SO' followed by a numeric sequence. This field uniquely identifies an order in the system and is used to track individual transactions.

name: Purchase Order Bill
description: A unique identifier for each bill, formatted as a string with a prefix and sequential number.

name: Receipt Timing
description: The exact date and time when the goods were received at the facility, recorded to track delivery timelines.

name: Receipt Verification Method
description: The method used to verify and record the receipt of goods, specifically scanning a pallet label with an SSCC code against the shipping notice.

name: Refund
description: A unique identifier for each refund transaction, formatted as a string with a prefix and numeric suffix.

name: Route
description: The identifier for the delivery route, such as R-07 or R-12. This helps categorize deliveries by geographic or logistical path.

name: Sale
description: The date when a sales transaction occurred.

name: Selling Price In Indian Rupees
description: The selling price of the product in Indian Rupees, as quoted to customers at point of sale or online marketplace.

name: Settlement Date
description: The date when payments are settled and funds are transferred to the business.

name: Shelf Audit
description: The timestamp indicating when the record was last updated or audited.

name: Shipment
description: A unique identifier for each shipment, formatted as a text string with the prefix 'SHP' followed by a sequence number.

name: Shipment Details
description: Shipment-level metadata that describes the contents, weight, and verification status of goods associated with a pallet. This includes delivery tracking and logistics data.

name: Shipment (store014.warehouse.shipping_notice_lines)
description: A unique identifier for each shipment, formatted as a text string with the prefix 'SHP' followed by a date and sequence number.

name: Status Updated Date And Time
description: The date and time when the status of the payment transaction was last updated.

name: Stock Adjustment
description: The timestamp indicating when the record was last adjusted or updated in the system. This captures the exact moment of change, useful for audit trails and tracking modification history.

name: Supply Chain Flow
description: The type of supply chain or distribution path a product follows, either direct to consumer (DC) or distributed through a secondary distributor (DSD).

name: Total Amount In Indian Rupees
description: The total amount of the transaction in Indian Rupees (INR).

name: Transaction Reference Number
description: A unique identifier assigned to each transaction, typically used for tracking and reference in payment processing.

name: Transaction Status
description: The current state of the payment transaction, indicating whether it succeeded, failed, or was returned by the system.

name: UPI Credits Count
description: The total number of UPI transactions that were credited to the customer's account during the period.

name: Upi Settlements
description: The total amount of revenue generated before any deductions, such as refunds or merchant discount rates.

name: Write Off
description: The date when the inventory item was written off.
